name: vch_oagc
description: Vibrio cholerae O-antigen gene clusters (OAGC, 190 OL loci) + ompW control
note: V. cholerae O-antigen biosynthetic locus (OL) references from the Murase 2022 global O-serogroup genomic dissection (doi:10.1099/mgen.0.000860; INSDC LC594800-LC594991), with the N16961 ompW CDS as species control. Cluster snapshot of the Hangzhou CDC build; 190 OL loci + ompW. The panel reports locus-level matches (OL/O), not serologically verified serogroups; Inaba vs Ogawa and OLU (untypeable) loci are not resolved.

references.citation: Murase K, Arakawa E, Izumiya H, Iguchi A, Takemura T, Kikuchi T, Nakagawa I, Thomson NR, Ohnishi M, Morita M. Genomic dissection of the Vibrio cholerae O-serogroup global reference strains: reassessing our view of diversity and plasticity between two chromosomes. Microb Genom 2022;8(8):mgen000860.
references.note: Source of the O-antigen biosynthetic locus (OL) reference set; the combined GenBank file covers the O-serogroup reference strains, NCBI BioProject PRJDB8600 (LC594800-LC594991).

references.citation: Nandi B, Nandy RK, Mukhopadhyay S, Nair GB, Shimada T, Ghose AC. Rapid method for species-specific identification of Vibrio cholerae using primers targeted to the gene of outer membrane protein OmpW. J Clin Microbiol 2000;38(11):4145-4151.
references.note: ompW species-control marker; the control locus is the N16961 ompW CDS (NC_002506.1:819609-820262).

caveats: The OL reference set contains many clusters that have not been serologically verified. An OL/O call is a locus match, not a confirmed O serogroup; confirm with agglutination or a validated serotyping scheme.

OLU (untypeable/unassigned) loci are not yet included. An OUT call means no reference locus matched, not that the isolate is non-O1/non-O139; additional OLU references will be added from public databases.
OL1-Inaba and OL1-Ogawa both map to O1 in this build; the panel does not resolve Inaba vs Ogawa (wbeT phase variation) or other subserotypes.
O-antigen loci can recombine and assemblies can be partial. A weak or partial locus match should be confirmed; coverage/identity and the cluster evidence columns are part of the call.
ctxA/ctxB are deliberately absent from this database; they belong to the separate vch_vf panel.
ompW is a species-control marker, not an absolute species or serogroup determinant; interpret it with the isolate context.

Bundled snapshot of the Hangzhou CDC build from a combined GenBank file (INSDC LC594800-LC594991, BioProject PRJDB8600); sequences retain their INSDC provenance and the panel is not a serologically validated scheme.
